prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A single chubby cartoon baby giraffe drawn as a glossy 3D-rendered comedy mascot sticker, centered on a plain flat pale-cream background. The creature is absurdly round and huggable: an oversized spherical head, a very short thick stubby neck, a fat pear-shaped belly, and tiny sausage-like arms and legs. Its skin is bright buttery yellow with soft rounded caramel-brown patches, two little fuzzy-knobbed horns on top of the head, small floppy ears, and a tiny tufted tail. It is laughing hysterically with its head thrown far back and its whole body wobbling: the mouth gapes enormously wide, occupying most of the face, a huge dark-red cavern with a fat pink tongue and two tiny blunt teeth, the corners stretched almost to the ears. The eyes are squeezed completely shut into two thin upward-curving crescent lines, with cartoon teardrops of laughter squirting sideways out of them. Bright pink blush ovals on the cheeks, stubby arms flung up in the air, belly jutting forward, one foot kicking up. Clean thick dark outlines, smooth toy-like plastic shading, soft even studio lighting, saturated cheerful colors, exaggerated slapstick expression, low-detail simple shapes, square sticker composition with generous empty margin.
